title: Proof Of Loss Source
description: Proof Of Loss contract normalized from the DocuBricks Insurance library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: docubricks-insurance-proof-of-loss-source
  title: Proof Of Loss Source
  description: Proof Of Loss contract normalized from the DocuBricks Insurance library.
  version: insurance_proof_of_loss_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: insurance/proof_of_loss
    sourcePath: Schemas/insurance/proof_of_loss
    sourceVersion: insurance_proof_of_loss_v1
    sourceDigest: e37cd1b43395a0ea5f9ce44850d3b39bc529bc2398064cd68091a311203728aa
    derivedFrom: docubricks-insurance-proof-of-loss
spec:
  documentType: proof_of_loss
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - loss-date
        - signed-date
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - cause-of-loss
        - claim-number
        - mortgagee-or-loss-payee
        - other-insurance
    - id: financials
      title: Financials
      description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - actual-cash-value
        - claimed-amount
        - deductible-amount
        - replacement-cost-value
    - id: line-items
      title: Line Items
      description: Line Items fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - supporting-documents
    - id: parties
      title: Parties
      description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - insured-name
        - notary-name
    - id: property-or-asset
      title: Property Or Asset
      description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - loss-location
    - id: risk-and-compliance
      title: Risk And Compliance
      description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - policy-number
  fields:
    - id: claim-number
      name: claim_number
      label: Claim Number
      description: Claim number.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/claim_number
    - id: policy-number
      name: policy_number
      label: Policy Number
      description: Policy number.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/policy_number
    - id: insured-name
      name: insured_name
      label: Insured Name
      description: Insured submitting proof of loss.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/insured_name
    - id: loss-date
      name: loss_date
      label: Loss Date
      description: Date of loss.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/loss_date
    - id: loss-location
      name: loss_location
      label: Loss Location
      description: Location of loss.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/loss_location
    - id: cause-of-loss
      name: cause_of_loss
      label: Cause Of Loss
      description: Cause or origin of loss.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/cause_of_loss
    - id: claimed-amount
      name: claimed_amount
      label: Claimed Amount
      description: Total amount claimed.
      dataType: number
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/claimed_amount
    - id: actual-cash-value
      name: actual_cash_value
      label: Actual Cash Value
      description: Actual cash value stated.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/actual_cash_value
    - id: replacement-cost-value
      name: replacement_cost_value
      label: Replacement Cost Value
      description: Replacement cost value stated.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/replacement_cost_value
    - id: deductible-amount
      name: deductible_amount
      label: Deductible Amount
      description: Applicable deductible.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/deductible_amount
    - id: mortgagee-or-loss-payee
      name: mortgagee_or_loss_payee
      label: Mortgagee Or Loss Payee
      description: Mortgagee, lienholder, or loss payee.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/mortgagee_or_loss_payee
    - id: other-insurance
      name: other_insurance
      label: Other Insurance
      description: Other insurance disclosed.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/other_insurance
    - id: supporting-documents
      name: supporting_documents
      label: Supporting Documents
      description: Documents supporting the proof of loss.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/supporting_documents
    - id: signed-date
      name: signed_date
      label: Signed Date
      description: Date signed.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/signed_date
    - id: notary-name
      name: notary_name
      label: Notary Name
      description: Notary name if notarized.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/notary_name
  validationRules:
    - id: claim-number-present
      severity: error
      description: claim_number is required for Proof of Loss extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: claim_number
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: claim_number
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: claim_number IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(claim_number)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: policy-number-present
      severity: error
      description: policy_number is required for Proof of Loss extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: policy_number
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: policy_number
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: policy_number IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(policy_number)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: insured-name-present
      severity: error
      description: insured_name is required for Proof of Loss extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: insured_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: insured_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: insured_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(insured_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: claimed-amount-present
      severity: error
      description: claimed_amount is required for Proof of Loss extraction.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: claimed_amount
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: claimed_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: claimed_amount IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(claimed_amount)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: claimed-amount-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: claimed_amount should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: claimed_amount
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: claimed_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: claimed_amount IS NULL OR claimed_amount >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: actual-cash-value-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: actual_cash_value should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: actual_cash_value
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: actual_cash_value
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: actual_cash_value IS NULL OR actual_cash_value >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: replacement-cost-value-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: replacement_cost_value should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: replacement_cost_value
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: replacement_cost_value
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: replacement_cost_value IS NULL OR replacement_cost_value >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: deductible-amount-non-negative
      severity: warning
      description: deductible_amount should be non-negative when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: deductible_amount
          - op: gte
            left:
              field: deductible_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: deductible_amount IS NULL OR deductible_amount >= 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      claim_number:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Proof of Loss workflow.
      policy_number:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Proof of Loss workflow.
      claimed_amount:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Proof of Loss workflow.
      signed_date:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: High-impact field for Proof of Loss workflow.
      insured_name:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Required field for Proof of loss extraction.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Proof of Loss documents mix policy, coverage, claim, party, financial, and regulatory notice context.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      claim_number:
        type: string
        description: Claim number.
      policy_number:
        type: string
        description: Policy number.
      insured_name:
        type: string
        description: Insured submitting proof of loss.
      loss_date:
        type: date
        description: Date of loss.
        format: date
      loss_location:
        type: string
        description: Location of loss.
      cause_of_loss:
        type: string
        description: Cause or origin of loss.
      claimed_amount:
        type: number
        description: Total amount claimed.
      actual_cash_value:
        type: number
        description: Actual cash value stated.
      replacement_cost_value:
        type: number
        description: Replacement cost value stated.
      deductible_amount:
        type: number
        description: Applicable deductible.
      mortgagee_or_loss_payee:
        type: string
        description: Mortgagee, lienholder, or loss payee.
      other_insurance:
        type: string
        description: Other insurance disclosed.
      supporting_documents:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Documents supporting the proof of loss.
      signed_date:
        type: date
        description: Date signed.
        format: date
      notary_name:
        type: string
        description: Notary name if notarized.
    required:
      - claim_number
      - policy_number
      - insured_name
      - claimed_amount
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: insurance_collateral_protection
    outputContract:
      fields_object: extracted_fields
      confidence_object: confidence
      metadata_object: extraction_metadata
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - claim_number
          - policy_number
          - insured_name
          - claimed_amount
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - financials
          - line_items
          - parties
          - property_or_asset
          - risk_and_compliance
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields: []
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
